root_fallback_reason: The preferred OSSFS path raised OSError errno 5 while closing fold 6 model archive during the first formal attempt. That attempt had no committed prediction table; its incomplete fold archives are retained under .runtime/failed_ossfs_attempt and are excluded from formal results. The complete frozen-feature probe run is restarted in this stable fallback directory.

protocol.fold_source: E75.4 frozen features with verified E74.4 test indices

prompt_sources.source: Reused byte-identical E75.4 prompt cache and prompt_banks.json; no new text encoding

limitations: Historical E74.4 model selection used test folds as validation and preprocessing preceded outer CV; graph inference is transductive.
Fold 2 retains the historical train/test overlap for rows 377 and 407 in the base model, while both are excluded from new probe fitting and selection.
The frozen base was trained using outer-training labels, so inner-fold base scores are not independent OOF base scores; lambda selection remains optimistically biased.
Sixteen CAM tokens are latent feature slots, not anatomical ROIs; residual probes only assess constrained predictive utility on frozen representations.
